description: This Java source file defines the TaskFactory class responsible for creating instances of scheduled tasks within the OpenMRS platform. It manages loading task classes dynamically, wrapping tasks with threading wrappers, and handling associated exceptions and logging.

classes.name: TaskFactory
classes.description: A singleton factory class responsible for creating and initializing scheduled Task instances, handling class loading and threading wrappers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TaskFactory.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Task instance based on the provided TaskDefinition, loading the class dynamically, wrapping it with threading, and initializing it.
